name: KubeCompass desktop Kubernetes workspace
description: Platform-neutral contract for the K-Dex-derived desktop workspace; topology uses semantic Explorer Levels, typed Port Paths, and a three-pane Map/List/Port Table shell. webapp is the schema's nearest application-platform value.

provenance.note: Current K-Dex desktop shell is the reference; native desktop is not represented by the schema enum.

criteria.statement: Shared fixtures produce the same workflows and outcomes on macOS and Linux adapters.

provenance.note: Shared-core Linux tests pass; full Linux GUI route parity remains pending.

criteria.statement: Focus, keyboard commands, selection/filter semantics, tab routing, retry, and cancellation match across adapters.

provenance.note: Platform idioms may differ but task semantics may not.

criteria.statement: Hierarchy, density, semantic tokens, and meaningful states match without a pixel-identical native-control claim.

provenance.note: Visual review checks hierarchy and states.

criteria.statement: The shared core remains platform-neutral while adapter-specific views stay isolated; source parity never means shared SwiftUI view source on Linux.

provenance.note: Makoni/Swift Adwaita is a native adapter and SwiftUI source compatibility is absent.

criteria.statement: Shared-package tests, trace, 10k-row performance, native window smoke, Debian packaging, and fresh installation pass; full Linux GUI routes, accessibility/keyboard, startup/RSS, and live-cluster behavior require separate evidence.

provenance.note: Current evidence is intentionally bounded; do not mark full Linux coverage passed.

criteria.statement: Every topology relationship, Route, and Port Hop exposes its Evidence Level and provenance; unavailable inputs and unresolved references remain visible, and no selector or object reference is described as packet flow or connectivity.

provenance.note: Source and a deterministic wide runtime review show evidence and explicit proof/non-proof copy; disposable fixture conformance verifies the API shapes, while production-provider coverage remains open.

criteria.statement: Cluster, Infrastructure, Workloads, Network, Policy & Dependencies, and Evidence levels answer distinct questions, preserve selection through breadcrumbs, and support Focus, Trace, and Inventory modes.

provenance.note: Current source and the wide runtime fixture show the semantic hierarchy and controls; narrow and full state-matrix review remain unverified.

criteria.statement: Map, List, and Port Table expose the same typed Port Paths, including protocol, port identity, targetPort resolution, EndpointSlice readiness, and declared container ports with explicit unresolved or ambiguous states.

provenance.note: Unit fixtures cover typed resolution and status variants; disposable kind conformance verifies their API shapes; the rendered Port Table verifies presentation. Arbitrary production clusters remain outside this evidence.

criteria.statement: Map, List, and Port Table have equivalent keyboard and screen-reader outcomes, stable focus, textual evidence labels, high-contrast support, reduced-motion behavior, and no meaning conveyed by color alone.

provenance.note: The current semantic List has fixture-observed keyboard evidence; tiered and Port Table accessibility remain untested.

criteria.statement: Selection, filter, tier transition, loading cancellation, frame time, startup, memory, and scale behavior are measured at defined fixture sizes on both desktop adapters.

provenance.note: The Release core benchmark records a 10k graph build and sub-100ms queries, and automatic refresh completion is runtime-observed. GUI frame time, RSS, startup, and cross-adapter measurements remain open.
